## Summary

Describe the reusable improvement and why it belongs in this shared library.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any relevant limitations.

## Safety and Provenance

- [ ] The change contains no credentials, customer data, private hostnames,
      project codenames, usernames, IP addresses, or absolute local paths.
- [ ] Imported or adapted material is recorded in `SOURCES.md` with its
      license and attribution when known.
- [ ] Links and relative symlinks resolve from the repository root.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
